tao_eval: fyi running saturn-lite q4a-int4 onboarding and hit a reproducible detok/boundary glitch on mixed-orient testset (polyglot-subtitles). chrF: ar->en -3.1, ja->en -1.6 vs fp16. example below.

marie_onboard: paste run + sample pls

tao_eval: run id 2026-03-25-saturn-int4-shadow, model: saturn-lite v0.9, quant=int4 per-tensor dynamic, kernels=auto, tokenizer v2026-03-01. evalset: polyglot-subtitles (2.8k pairs). sample:
```
input (ar): "هذا (العنوان) مهم"
fp16: "This (title) is important"
int4: "This (title) isimportant"
// note: missing space after closing paren -> fused subtokens
```

niko_research: could be invisible-joiner (ZWJ/ZWNJ) or post-detok merge affected by tiny logit shifts in accumulation path. did you run with RT_ACCUM_FP16/RT_KV_FP16?

marie_onboard: also reproduced on ja sample where ruby/annotation marker got dropped and punctuation reflowed for vertical rendering. tokenizer roundtrip on inputs is fine, issue only at model output.

ken_ops: try forcing fp16 accumulation and kv to isolate numeric path. set env RT_ACCUM_FP16=true RT_KV_FP16=true or runtime flags.

tao_eval: ran with both flags. ar->en chrF recovered to -0.5, ja->en to -0.2. latency ~+12ms p50. seems accumulation/kv rounding explains most of delta.

niko_research: please capture logits + token ids + kv dumps for failing sample (int4 and fp16-kv) and attach to ticket SATURN-INT4-900. i'll look at kernel selection and scale quantization ranges. also try `--no-merging-postprocess` to see if detok post-step masks it.

marie_onboard: opened issue https://redwood.internal/issue/SATURN-INT4-900 and pushed a small fuzz harness that inserts ZWJ/ZWNJ and bracket-adjacent cases. also added ci gating: pause int4 canary on polyglot-subtitles until kernel triage.

ci-bot: launched CI run SATURN-INT4-900 (#3120) on eng-ml/saturn-lite-int4 builders x4. logs: https://ci.redwood/internal/3120

ken_ops: for Dedicated/on-prem customers we'll add a temporary quant-recommendation: "preserve-invisible-joiners=true" and recommend KV_FP16 fallback for mixed-orient locales in Optimize. I'll draft the change.

tao_eval: thanks all, monitoring the ticket. :pray:
